title: Lightly Grilled Slovakian Pork Wrap
description: A light and refreshing Slovakian pork dish featuring dark rum and served in a pandan leaf wrap.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
Season the pork tenderloin with salt, pepper, and 2 tsp of paprika.
Grill the pork tenderloin for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 633C.
Let the pork rest for 2 minutes before slicing it thinly.
In a small bowl, mix together 2 tbsp of dark rum, 1 tsp of honey, and 1 tsp of Dijon mustard.
Brush the rum mixture onto the sliced pork tenderloin.
Warm the pandan leaf wraps according to package instructions.
Assemble the wraps by placing a few slices of the rum-glazed pork tenderloin onto the center of each wrap, followed by a few slices of cucumber and a sprinkle of chopped fresh parsley.
